channel.title: Usman Ahmed
channel.description: Transportation researcher — traffic systems, safety, and mobility.

item.title: NSF grant awarded for microtransit equity research
item.description: Delighted to share that our project, Equitable Microtransit Design for Mid-Sized Cities, has been awarded funding by the National Science Foundation (Award #0000000). The three-year project will study on-demand microtransit service design in partnership with [Regional Transit Agency]. See the Projects page for details.

item.title: Paper accepted in Transportation Research Part C
item.description: Our paper, “Corridor-level safety analytics using connected-vehicle trajectory data,” has been accepted for publication in Transportation Research Part C: Emerging Technologies. Congratulations to co-authors Jane Doe and Alex Smith. See Publications for the full citation.

item.title: Invited talk at TRB Annual Meeting
item.description: I gave an invited talk, “Mixed Autonomy Traffic at Signalized Intersections,” at the 105th Transportation Research Board (TRB) Annual Meeting in Washington, D.C. Slides are linked from the Publications page.

item.title: Welcoming a new Ph.D. student to the Mobility Systems Lab
item.description: The lab welcomes [Student Name], who joins as a Ph.D. student this fall to work on data-driven transportation safety analytics. Welcome!
